messages:
ana: Starting a softstart deploy for `llm-route-v3` behind feature flag `soft-llm-route` in eu-west. Plan: 0.25% -> 2% -> 10% -> 100% with 10m holds. Pin baseline v3.1 to slice 0 until green. Any blockers?

lee: No blockers from infra. 0.25% is fine given traffic tonight. Make sure cost gating is enabled (token-cost threshold).

devin: Good. Define rollback gates so Ops can act quickly.

ana: Rollback gates: p99 latency +120ms vs baseline sustained for 2m OR error-rate >0.4% for 3m OR cost/unit up by >15% for 5m. Also monitor token-cost and batch-size distribution.

sasha: I'll wire the diff-eval hooks against eval set C and alert if semantic similarity drops >1.5%.

deploybot: queued rollout `soft-llm-route` model=llm-route-v3 steps=[0.25,2,10,100] holds=600s monitors=[p50,p95,p99,5xx-rate,error-rate,token-cost] notify=@oncall fallback=quantized-ok

oncall: Will watch dashboards and the post-deploy log. Post a short release note here when canary starts.

harper: Added a Console note: `slices/2024-05-08-softstart-llm-route`. Remember to record the mapping for audits.

ana: Pin command for reproducibility: `deploybot start --flag soft-llm-route --model llm-route-v3 --pin 0:v3.1 --steps 0.25,2,10,100 --hold 600 --cost-gate 1.15`

lee: Question: does deploybot auto-fallback to `v3-int8` when GPU contention rises? Last month it fell back too aggressively.

ana: Fallback policy is `fallback:threshold=latency:200ms|gpu_util:0.9` with `fallback:cooldown=45s`. Also `fallback:grace=20s` to reduce thrash.

deploybot: canary started @1725601290 region=eu-west slice=0.25% status=running

oncall: Initial telemetry: p50 +8ms, p95 +20ms, p99 +40ms, no 5xx spike. :thumbsup:

sasha: Diff-eval C reporting +1.2% semantic drift (alert threshold 1.5%)  below threshold.

devin: If drift crosses 1.5% AND p99 crosses +100ms, prefer immediate abort. Also call out to product for any user-impacting changes.

harper: Noted. Saved mapping and changelog stub in Console.

deploybot: holdpoint reached @1725601590 next_step=2% status=holding

ana: Proceeding to 2% in 30s if no gate violations.

oncall: Watching cost gauge; set me an alert if token-cost > baseline * 1.12 for 3m.

sasha: Reminder: rollback runbook https://go/runbooks/soft-llm-rollback - shortlink.

deploybot: 2% step applied @1725601650 status=running next_hold=10m

devin: Quick note: if we see increased tail latency but no errors, consider reducing batch sizes rather than rolling back. We can flip `batch_hint=low` for the slice.

ana: Good point. Command to adjust mid-rollout: `deploybot patch --flag soft-llm-route --set batch_hint=low`

oncall: Update: post-2% telemetry looks stable. p99 within +60ms, error-rate stable. No cost surge.

harper: Diff-eval C now at +0.9% drift. All good.

sasha: Once we hit 10% I'll publish a terse release note: what changed, rollback gates, contact.

ana: If anything goes sideways: `deploybot abort --reason "regen-issue"` then `deploybot drain --to v3.1`  standard procedure.

deploybot: next step queued: 10% @1725602250 (subject to holds/metrics).
